dialog.text: I am Computer, I'm here to teach you how to do your job. Listen to me and everything will be alright.
In this world, time passes with each action you take. An action consist of any movement "W, A, S, D", creating a building, wall, gate, or turret.

Let's start slow. You see these blue gems on the floor, they are very important to us, it's a resource that can be used to make buildings that can generate even more resources, they can also be used to generate bullets. More on that later.
Move (W, A, S, D) to the gems to collect the gems and start.
